name: Factory Night Shift
backstory: When the supervisors leave, the first three machines take the arena booking. The overtime crew follows: six factory robots turn a night shift into three pairs, two trios, and a very expensive maintenance report.
strategy_personality: Smash Bot completes the workshop-heavy second pair. Zoom Bot and Spin Bot finish the overtime trio. Factory tools and racing flavour remain visual identity; arena behaviour uses the shared strategy.

original_record.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: Armoured Souls individual robot game portrait. Generate ONE square 1:1 image of ONE complete source-faithful robot, not an original substitute.
Scene/backdrop: quiet charcoal-to-black industrial studio gradient, subtle dark floor and restrained low haze.
Style/medium: premium realistic industrial sci-fi hard-surface 3D rendering, believable metal, fine scratches and restrained paint wear, preserving source geometry and colours. Match the established Armoured Souls portrait collection.
Composition: three-quarter view, complete full body with head, all feet/legs and equipment contained in frame, centered at about 80% of square canvas with at least 5% clear margin around every extremity. Readable silhouette at 512px.

source_notes:
**Franchise:** Robo Rally  
**Strategy:** Squadron · **Target roster:** 6 robots  
**Opening:** 3 robots · **Hard cap:** 6 robots  
**Catalogue key:** `factory-night-shift`

**Proposed robots:** Twonky; Hulk X90; Hammer Bot; Smash Bot; Zoom Bot; Spin Bot.

**Source edition:** Renegade Game Studios 2023 core edition: Twonky, Hulk X90, Hammer Bot, Smash Bot, Zoom Bot, and Spin Bot. Use that edition's player-mat illustrations and matching miniatures.

**Naming:** Use the six source names. Smash Bot is the selected edition's name; do not replace it with the older Squash Bot or mix in Twitch or Trundle Bot.

**Backstory:** When the supervisors leave, the first three machines take the arena booking. The overtime crew follows: six factory robots turn a night shift into three pairs, two trios, and a very expensive maintenance report.

**Purchasing personality:** Smash Bot completes the workshop-heavy second pair. Zoom Bot and Spin Bot finish the overtime trio. Factory tools and racing flavour remain visual identity; arena behaviour uses the shared strategy.

**Robot blueprints**

| Slot | Arena robot name | Source identity | Joins | Arena role | Loadout | Stance / yield | Build_Focus |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | **Twonky** | Twonky | Opening | Mobile line shooter | `single` | balanced / 15% | Versatile |
| 2 | **Hulk X90** | Hulk X90 | Opening | Defensive anchor | `weapon_shield` | defensive / 25% | Warden |
| 3 | **Hammer Bot** | Hammer Bot | Opening | Close workshop fighter | `two_handed` | offensive / 10% | Bruiser |
| 4 | **Smash Bot** | Smash Bot | Growth #1 | Heavy line shooter | `two_handed` | balanced / 15% | Bruiser |
| 5 | **Zoom Bot** | Zoom Bot | Growth #2 | Mobile ranged support | `single` | balanced / 15% | Deadeye |
| 6 | **Spin Bot** | Spin Bot | Growth #3 | Close skirmisher | `dual_wield` | offensive / 10% | Sprinter |

**Weapon paths** — stage 0 on recruitment, then stage 1. Prices are combined list-price equipment subtotals, not total robot or stable purchase costs.

| Slot | Range from weapons | Stage 0 | Stage 1 |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | mid | Bolt Carbine (₡93,000) | Nova Caster (₡425,000) |
| 2 | short | Laser Pistol + Light Shield (₡108,000) | Volt Sabre + Aegis Bulwark (₡834,000) |
| 3 | melee | War Club (₡84,000) | Heavy Hammer (₡478,000) |
| 4 | mid | Training Rifle (₡50,000) | Plasma Cannon (₡408,000) |
| 5 | long | Beam Pistol (₡93,000) | Particle Lance (₡425,000) |
| 6 | short | Laser Pistol x2 (₡114,000) | Volt Sabre x2 (₡850,000) |

**Equipment planning totals:** opening trio ₡285,000; recruits 4–6 at stage 0 ₡257,000; all six at stage 1 ₡3,420,000; 8 equipped weapon/shield items at the six-robot target. The stage-0 equipment component of the slot-5-and-6 recruitment reserve is ₡207,000, plus both robot frames, required facilities, and maintenance reserve.

**Refinement plans — after all six robots reach stage 1**

Execute each row from left to right. Costs and workshop gates for every operation are in the [shared refinement rules](#squadron-refinement-rules). Main/offhand targets are explicit; all six robots have a non-empty plan.

| Slot | Robot | Ordered refinement steps | Refinement subtotal |
|---|---|---|---:|
| 1 | **Twonky** | Main Nova Caster: Sharpen 1 (−10% cooldown) → Main Nova Caster: Forge 1 (+8% damage) | ₡700,000 |
| 2 | **Hulk X90** | Offhand Aegis Bulwark: Hone Evasion Thrusters −5→0 → Main Volt Sabre: Hone Combat Power 8→10 → Main Volt Sabre: Augment Adaptive AI +3 (new) → Main Volt Sabre: Sharpen 1 (−10% cooldown) → Main Volt Sabre: Forge 1 (+8% damage) | ₡1,170,000 |
| 3 | **Hammer Bot** | Main Heavy Hammer: Hone Hydraulic Systems 8→10 → Main Heavy Hammer: Augment Armor Plating +3 (new) → Main Heavy Hammer: Sharpen 1 (−10% cooldown) → Main Heavy Hammer: Forge 1 (+8% damage) | ₡920,000 |
| 4 | **Smash Bot** | Main Plasma Cannon: Hone Combat Power 7→10 → Main Plasma Cannon: Hone Critical Systems 6→10 → Main Plasma Cannon: Augment Hull Integrity +3 (new) → Main Plasma Cannon: Sharpen 1 (−10% cooldown) → Main Plasma Cannon: Forge 1 (+8% damage) | ₡1,130,000 |
| 5 | **Zoom Bot** | Main Particle Lance: Hone Targeting Systems 8→10 → Main Particle Lance: Augment Weapon Control +3 (new) → Main Particle Lance: Sharpen 1 (−10% cooldown) → Main Particle Lance: Forge 1 (+8% damage) | ₡920,000 |
| 6 | **Spin Bot** | Main Volt Sabre: Hone Attack Speed 4→7 → Main Volt Sabre: Augment Evasion Thrusters +2 (new) → Main Volt Sabre: Sharpen 1 (−10% cooldown) → Main Volt Sabre: Forge 1 (+8% damage) | ₡870,000 |

**Refinement budget:** ₡5,710,000 across six robots. Final stage-1 equipment plus refinement totals ₡9,130,000; stage-0 purchases and facility, frame, training, and maintenance costs are additional.

**Portrait blueprints** — show one complete body using the shared art direction. Signature features identify the source; every active weapon or shield must map to the equipment allocations above.

| Slot | Portrait and equipment brief |
|---|---|
| 1 | Match the 2023 Twonky miniature and labelled player mat. Preserve the source face, proportions, and chassis; add one compact mid-range arena weapon. |
| 2 | Match the 2023 Hulk X90 body and labelled player mat. Preserve its source construction; one short-range weapon and one original arena shield. |
| 3 | Match the 2023 Hammer Bot model, retaining its recognizable industrial tool silhouette. Use one two-handed melee allocation; source tools add no extra free attacks. |
| 4 | Match the 2023 Smash Bot model and player-mat illustration. Retain its complete source chassis; one heavy mid-range arena weapon. |
| 5 | Match the 2023 Zoom Bot model and labelled player mat. Preserve source locomotion and proportions; one long-range arena weapon. |
| 6 | Match the 2023 Spin Bot model and labelled player mat. Preserve its distinctive body construction; two short-range arena weapon allocations. |

**Named teams and fixed membership** — all names are original Armoured Souls team labels.

| Format | Team name | Fixed members | Forms |
|---|---|---|---|
| 2v2 | **Docking Bay Duo** | 1 Twonky + 2 Hulk X90 | Opening trio |
| 2v2 | **Hammer and Anvil** | 3 Hammer Bot + 4 Smash Bot | When slot 4 joins |
| 2v2 | **Conveyor Chaos** | 5 Zoom Bot + 6 Spin Bot | When slot 6 joins |
| 3v3 | **First Shift** | 1 Twonky + 2 Hulk X90 + 3 Hammer Bot | Opening trio |
| 3v3 | **Overtime Crew** | 4 Smash Bot + 5 Zoom Bot + 6 Spin Bot | When slot 6 joins |

**Shared parameters:** apply the Squadron recruitment, fixed-team, event-order, budget, tuning, refinement, and image rules below. Slots 1–3 open together; buy 4, then 5, then 6. No reserve slots or substitution alternatives are included.

References: [publisher core-edition reference](https://renegadegamestudios.com/robo-rally/), [official 2023 rulebook and model illustrations](https://renegadegamestudios.com/content/File%20Storage%20for%20site/Rulebooks/Robo%20Rally/RoboRally_Rulebook_WEB.pdf), [publisher Twonky reference](https://heroscape.renegadegamestudios.com/blog/october-staff-picks/), [secondary six-name and renamed-Smash-Bot cross-check](https://theglassmeeple.com/robo-rally-reboot/).
purchasing_plan: Open with slots 1–3. Recruit slot 4, then fund the complete slot-5/slot-6 pair before buying 5 followed by 6. Finish all six final loadouts before refinement. Invest in slot order 1,4,2,5,3,6, with Hone, Augment, first Sharpen and first Forge passes through Workshop L1, L3, L5 and L8. Keep funding and prestige-gated steps pending.

equipment_budget.excludes: Frames, facilities, training, upkeep, repair costs, discounts and resale. Alternatives excluded.
